# FLX-6002: reserved word held for flux-expr/2

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

This word is reserved and has no meaning in flux-expr/1. A grammar that needs it is flux-expr/2; raise the request there.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6002
```
